customMethods.name: deleteState
customMethods.script:
#When a user deletes a downtime state event, we presume they are saying that the asset was running at this time, so we are not actually deleting the state event
	#just setting it to running for that time
	
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	userName = self.session.props.auth.user.userName
	assetId = self.view.custom.filter.assetId
	stateEventData = self.view.custom.table.data
	selectedEvents = self.view.custom.table.selection.data
	if len(selectedEvents) == 0: return
	
	stateCode = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('stateCode', system.kanoa.asset.getAssetStates({'assetId': assetId, 'stateName': 'Running'}))
	if stateCode is None:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': "Cannot find a 'Running' state code for this asset. Unable to clear the downtime event."})	
		return
	
	if len(selectedEvents) == 1:
		stateEventInfo = dict(stateEventData[selectedEvents[0]['index']])
		if stateEventInfo['stateTypeName'] != 'Running':
			stateEventInfo['tStamp'] = stateEventInfo['startDate']
			stateEventInfo['stateCode'] = stateCode
			stateEventInfo['assetStateId'] = assetId
			note = "%s set to Running by %s"%(stateEventInfo['stateName'], userName)
			stateEventInfo['note'] = "%s. %s"%(stateEventInfo['note'], note) if stateEventInfo['note'] else note
			self.updateState(stateEventInfo)
	else:
		eventDates = []
		for selection in selectedEvents:
			eventDates.append(stateEventData[selection['index']]['startDate'])
		
		startDate = min(eventDates)
		endDate = max(eventDates)
		system.perspective.print("deleteStateEvents() called with %s"%{'assetId': assetId, 'startDate': startDate, 'endDate': endDate})
		system.kanoa.event.deleteStateEvents({'assetId': assetId, 'startDate': startDate, 'endDate': endDate}, userId)
		stateEventInfo = {'assetId': assetId, 'assetStateId': assetId, 'stateCode': stateCode, 'tStamp': startDate, 'note': 'Downtime events set to running by %s'%userName}
		system.perspective.print("addStateEvent() called with %s"%stateEventInfo)		
		stateEventId = system.kanoa.event.addStateEvent(stateEventInfo, userId)
		stateEventInfo['stateEventId'] = stateEventId
		stateEventInfo['origAssetId'] = assetId
		stateEventInfo['origStateCode'] = assetId
		system.kanoa.event.updateStateEvent(stateEventInfo, userId)		

	self.clearTableSelection()
	system.perspective.sendMessage("DTUpdated", {})

	return

customMethods.name: updateState
customMethods.script:
'''
	1 - If the state event start and end match, this event is in a single production mode -> update this event
	2 - If the state event start does not match, this event started in a previous mode -> add a new event
	3 - If the state event end does not match, this event ended in a later mode -> add a new event at the end date, update this event
	'''

	system.perspective.print("updateState() called with %s"%stateEventInfo)
	log = system.util.getLogger('kanoa')
	debug = self.view.custom.debug
	
	if debug: log.info("updateState() called with %s"%stateEventInfo)

	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	userName = self.session.props.auth.user.userName
	
	stateEventInfo = dict(stateEventInfo)
	
	selection = self.view.custom.table.selection.data[0]
	stateEventInfo['startDate'] = system.kanoa.utilities.convertSQLTimeStamp(self.view.custom.table.data[selection['index']]['startDate'])
	stateEventInfo['endDate'] = system.kanoa.utilities.convertSQLTimeStamp(self.view.custom.table.data[selection['index']]['endDate'])
	stateEventInfo['stateStart'] = system.kanoa.utilities.convertSQLTimeStamp(self.view.custom.table.data[selection['index']]['stateStart'])
	stateEventInfo['stateEnd'] = system.kanoa.utilities.convertSQLTimeStamp(self.view.custom.table.data[selection['index']]['stateEnd'])
	
	if debug: log.info("startDate %s endDate %s stateStart %s stateEnd %s"%(stateEventInfo['startDate'], stateEventInfo['endDate'], stateEventInfo['stateStart'], stateEventInfo['stateEnd']))

	origStateEventInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.event.getStateEventById(stateEventInfo['stateEventId']), 0)
	
	if stateEventInfo['stateCode'] is None:
		system.perspective.sendMessage("sendFailerToast", {'message': 'State selected has no state code. Cannot assign this state to this event.'})
		if debug: log.error("No stateCode found")
		system.perspective.sendMessage("DTUpdated", {})
		return

	if stateEventInfo['startDate'] == stateEventInfo['stateStart'] and (stateEventInfo['stateEnd'] is None or stateEventInfo['endDate'] == stateEventInfo['stateEnd']):
		if debug: log.info("StartDates and endDates match. updateStateEvent() called")
		system.kanoa.event.updateStateEvent(stateEventInfo, userId)	
	else:
		if stateEventInfo['startDate'] != stateEventInfo['stateStart']:
			if debug: log.info("StartDates don't match: stateStart is from a previous mode. Adding a new stateEvent for this mode")
			stateEventInfo['tStamp'] = stateEventInfo['startDate']
			stateEventInfo['origStateCode'] = stateEventInfo['stateCode']
			stateEventId = system.kanoa.event.addStateEvent(stateEventInfo, userId)
			# This to show that an operator has edited this state event
			stateEventInfo['stateEventId'] = stateEventId
			system.kanoa.event.updateStateEvent(stateEventInfo, userId)

		if stateEventInfo['stateEnd'] is not None and stateEventInfo['endDate'] != stateEventInfo['stateEnd']:
			if debug: log.info("endDates don't match. Updating stateEvent and adding new stateEvent at endDate")
			origStateEventInfo['tStamp'] = stateEventInfo['endDate']
			if debug: log.info("Adding a new stateEvent for the next mode")
			system.kanoa.event.addStateEvent(origStateEventInfo, userId)
			if not stateEventInfo['note']: stateEventInfo['note'] = "%s changed to %s by %s"%(origStateEventInfo['stateName'],stateEventInfo['stateName'], userName) #Only create a note if none exists
			if debug: log.info("Updating this stateEvent %s"%stateEventInfo['stateEventId'])
			system.kanoa.event.updateStateEvent(stateEventInfo, userId)
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage("DTUpdated", {})
	return
